items.meta_title: Get an Access Key for VpnHood! CLIENT | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Where to get the access key VpnHood! CLIENT connects with: ask whoever runs a server, or run your own. VpnHood! CONNECT needs no key.
items.title: Get an access key
items.lead: VpnHood! CLIENT has no servers of its own, so it connects with an access key, also called a server key. You get one from whoever runs the server.
items.what_title: What an access key looks like
items.what_desc: It is one long line of text that starts with [key_prefix]. It tells the app which server to reach and lets you in, and you add it to the app only once.
items.ask_desc: A friend, a community or an organization that runs a VpnHood! server can send you a key, and some people may sell one. Copy the whole line.
items.ask_trust: Try to get your key from reputable people, as your traffic goes through their server. Keep it to yourself: anyone who has it can use that server.
items.own_desc: If you have nobody to ask, run a server of your own and create your keys there. See how to run your own VPN.
items.connect_title: Or skip the key: use an app with its own servers
items.connect_desc: VpnHood! CONNECT has servers of its own, so it needs no access key. See VpnHood! CONNECT.
